rfeExplain.text: What This Letter Is and Who Sent ItThis is a Request for Evidence (RFE) sent by the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) Potomac Service Center regarding Form I-765 for NAME 1 (Receipt Number RECEIPT 1, A-Number A NUMBER 1).Why You Received ItUSCIS is reviewing your post-completion Optional Practical Training (OPT) application and has determined that the currently submitted evidence is not sufficient to establish your eligibility.What It Asks ForYou must submit the following items together with this notice:A copy of your Form I-20 endorsed by your Designated School Official within the last 30 days showing the post-completion OPT recommendation.A copy of your passport biographic page.Two passport-style photographs with your name and A NUMBER 1 written lightly on the back.A copy of your marriage certificate for your F-2 dependent spouse, NAME 2.DeadlineYour response must be received by December 16, 2026.What Happens If You Do NothingIf USCIS does not receive the requested evidence by the deadline, they will decide your application based on the existing record, and it may be denied.Please check anything about your immigration status with your school's international student office or a qualified immigration attorney.

rfeFollowUp.text: The letter does not state whether the two passport-style photographs can be uploaded or if they must be mailed.It only states that you must send the notice with your response to the address provided in the letter.

bursarDraft.text: Subject: Registration hold / Spring term health insurance - NAME 1 (Student ID: ACCOUNT 1)Dear Office of Student Accounts,I am writing regarding the registration hold placed on my student account (Student ID: ACCOUNT 1, SEVIS ID: SEVIS 1) for the spring term health insurance charge of $1,286.00.I am submitting the online waiver form using my current policy details, including Member ID: ACCOUNT 2. Please find attached [describe the insurance policy documents you are attaching].Could you please confirm whether my waiver submission has been received and how long the review process typically takes before the registration hold is removed?Thank you for your assistance.Sincerely,NAME 1 ACCOUNT 1Note to the reader: Please check anything about your immigration status with your school's international student office or a qualified immigration attorney.

offlineOnDevice.text: This letter is from the Example State University's Student Accounts office and it is about a charge for your university health insurance.Here is what you need to do:Option 1: If you have health insurance that covers the university's needs, you must submit an online waiver form with your policy details by December 1, 2026.Option 2: If you do not want to waive the plan, you must pay the charge of $1,286.00 or sign up for a payment plan by December 9, 2026.If you do nothing, the hold on your registration will remain, and you will not be able to register for spring classes. You should speak to your international student advisor if you are worried about your enrollment.Disclaimer: This is an explanation, not legal advice. If this letter concerns immigration status or a legal dispute, please contact the school's international student office or a qualified attorney.
